faq.q: How much does Your Immigration Attorney charge?
faq.a: Your Immigration Attorney publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Your Immigration Attorney offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Your Immigration Attorney does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. It publishes material in Spanish.
